*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: C:\Users\joeyw\.gemini\antigravity\mcp\hybrid-automation-mcp-v2\models.py
+"""Typed request and result models for hybrid automation v2."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from typing import Any, Literal
+
+from pydantic import BaseModel, Field, model_validator
+
+
+class Point(BaseModel):
+    x: int
+    y: int
+
+
+class BoundingBox(BaseModel):
+    left: int
+    top: int
+    right: int
+    bottom: int
+
+    @property
+    def center(self) -> Point:
+        return Point(x=(self.left + self.right) // 2, y=(self.top + self.bottom) // 2)
+
+
+class TextMatch(BaseModel):
+    text: str
+    confidence: float = Field(ge=0.0, le=1.0)
+    box: BoundingBox
+    center: Point
+
+
+class ElementMatch(BaseModel):
+    label: str
+    confidence: float = Field(ge=0.0, le=1.0)
+    box: BoundingBox
+    center: Point
+    source: Literal["gemini", "ocr"] = "gemini"
+
+
+class WindowInfo(BaseModel):
+    title: str
+    left: int
+    top: int
+    width: int
+    height: int
+    active: bool = False
+    minimized: bool = False
+    maximized: bool = False
+
+
+class ToolResult(BaseModel):
+    success: bool
+    message: str
+    screenshot_path: str | None = None
+    data: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)
+    error: str | None = None
+
+    @classmethod
+    def ok(
+        cls,
+        message: str,
+        *,
+        screenshot_path: str | None = None,
+        **data: Any,
+    ) -> "ToolResult":
+        return cls(
+            success=True,
+            message=message,
+            screenshot_path=screenshot_path,
+            data=data,
+        )
+
+    @classmethod
+    def fail(
+        cls,
+        message: str,
+        *,
+        error: Exception | str | None = None,
+        screenshot_path: str | None = None,
+        **data: Any,
+    ) -> "ToolResult":
+        return cls(
+            success=False,
+            message=message,
+            screenshot_path=screenshot_path,
+            data=data,
+            error=str(error) if error is not None else message,
+        )
+
+
+class InspectRequest(BaseModel):
+    image_path: str | None = None
+    include_gemini: bool = False
+    prompt: str = "Identify the visible interactive UI elements."
+    confidence: float = Field(default=0.60, ge=0.0, le=1.0)
+
+
+class FindTextRequest(BaseModel):
+    target: str = Field(min_length=1)
+    image_path: str | None = None
+    confidence: float = Field(default=0.60, ge=0.0, le=1.0)
+    exact: bool = False
+
+
+class FindElementRequest(BaseModel):
+    description: str = Field(min_length=1)
+    image_path: str | None = None
+    confidence: float = Field(default=0.60, ge=0.0, le=1.0)
+
+
+class ClickRequest(BaseModel):
+    x: int | None = None
+    y: int | None = None
+    text: str | None = None
+    element: str | None = None
+    button: Literal["left", "middle", "right"] = "left"
+    duration: float = Field(default=0.5, ge=0.1, le=5.0)
+    verify: bool = True
+
+    @model_validator(mode="after")
+    def require_target(self) -> "ClickRequest":
+        if (self.x is None) != (self.y is None):
+            raise ValueError("x and y must be provided together")
+        if self.x is None and not self.text and not self.element:
+            raise ValueError("provide coordinates, text, or element")
+        return self
+
+
+class DragRequest(BaseModel):
+    start_x: int
+    start_y: int
+    end_x: int
+    end_y: int
+    duration: float = Field(default=0.8, ge=0.2, le=10.0)
+    button: Literal["left", "middle", "right"] = "left"
+    verify: bool = True
+
+
+class ScrollRequest(BaseModel):
+    clicks: int
+    x: int | None = None
+    y: int | None = None
+    duration: float = Field(default=0.4, ge=0.1, le=5.0)
+    verify: bool = False
+
+
+class TypeTextRequest(BaseModel):
+    text: str
+    interval: float = Field(default=0.03, ge=0.0, le=1.0)
+    verify: bool = False
+
+
+class KeyRequest(BaseModel):
+    key: str = Field(min_length=1)
+    presses: int = Field(default=1, ge=1, le=100)
+    interval: float = Field(default=0.05, ge=0.0, le=1.0)
+    verify: bool = False
+
+
+class HotkeyRequest(BaseModel):
+    keys: list[str] = Field(min_length=2)
+    interval: float = Field(default=0.05, ge=0.0, le=1.0)
+    verify: bool = False
+
+
+class TileSpec(BaseModel):
+    title: str = Field(min_length=1)
+    side: Literal["left", "right"]
+
+
+class WaitForTextRequest(BaseModel):
+    target: str = Field(min_length=1)
+    timeout: float = Field(default=15.0, gt=0.0, le=300.0)
+    poll_interval: float = Field(default=1.0, ge=0.2, le=30.0)
+    confidence: float = Field(default=0.60, ge=0.0, le=1.0)
+
+
+ActionName = Literal[
+    "click",
+    "double_click",
+    "drag",
+    "scroll",
+    "type_text",
+    "press_key",
+    "hotkey",
+    "focus_window",
+    "open_path",
+    "wait_for_text",
+]
+
+
+class ActionStep(BaseModel):
+    action: ActionName
+    parameters: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)
+    verify: bool = True
+    stop_on_error: bool = True
+
+
+class ActionPlanRequest(BaseModel):
+    steps: list[ActionStep] = Field(min_length=1, max_length=100)
+
*** End Patch
